note: Generated by Tools/atlas/build_physical_map.js from the atlas (seed 1207) and Data/World/regions.json; do not edit by hand. Docs: 10_World/physical_geography.md.

grid.origin: north-west corner; x east, y south; cell (i, j) covers map units [i*0.5, i*0.5+0.5) x [j*0.5, j*0.5+0.5); row j is rows[j]

elevation.fromAtlas: land: m = 750*h + 2600*max(0, h-0.5)^1.4 where h is the atlas relief (hgt in render()), averaged over 4x4 atlas pixels; sea: depth from the distance to the coast, -(5 + 120*smooth(0,4,d) + 1600*smooth(4,25,d)) m; carved passes lowered as listed in passes[]
elevation.water: shallow hollows drained by cutting their outlets (1456 cells lowered, at most 916 m); the rest are lakes (lakes[]): rows give the lake floor, lakes[].surfaceM the water

biomes.note: base terrain = the atlas biome (region terrain, chosen by the atlas noise); alpine = above the treeline, snow = above the snowline, beach = the atlas sandy rim, lake = filled depressions

regions.note: character k in a row = legend[index of k in "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABC"]; "." = sea

climate.seaLevelTempC: T(y) = 0.28*y (y in map units, 0 = north); lapse 6.5 C per km of height
climate.snowline: permanent snow where T < -5 C (and above 900 m; never on volcanic or demon ground); winter snow comes about 1000 m lower
climate.treeline: trees thin out where T < -1 C (above 700 m)

findings: reg_sylvaran: "Moonwell Lake" (10_World/world.md Sylvaran sub-zone) has no basin in the atlas relief; place it by hand when the region is built.

reg_ashira_vale: lore has "The Hill Road" (gazetteer Ashira Vale landmark: "The only road in"), but the atlas relief has no real heights to cross toward reg_sylvaran (highest point on the lowest way: 343 m). The heights should be added when the region is built.

reg_vharlen: lore has "The Frontier Forts passes" (gazetteer Vharlen: "The frontier forts stand in the passes of the northern mountains"), but the atlas relief has no real heights to cross toward reg_nox_dominion (highest point on the lowest way: 268 m). The heights should be added when the region is built.

Settlements the atlas relief puts above 2000 m (reached by road to within 2.5 km, then by their own stair or lift): reg_iron_hold "Karak Dûn" stands at 2616 m; reg_zarvan "Zarvan garden cities" stands at 2620 m; reg_stormreach "Stormreach cliff-towns" stands at 2810 m; reg_apu_highlands "terrace cities" stands at 2882 m. Their lore fits a high site only where it says so (Heavenreach eyries, Apu terrace cities); others should sit in a valley when the region is built.

reg_lirian: map.features has "coast" and the gazetteer says "The lagoon is shallow, brackish and protected from the sea by a long sandbar with three gaps that the city controls.", but in the atlas the region is landlocked (0 km of shoreline; the nearest sea is 25.5 km from its anchor).

reg_kitsune_isles: the gazetteer says "The isles are steep volcanic islands covered in forest, with sheltered coves, sea caves and a ring of reefs." but its terrain (spirit/forest) has no mountain/volcanic, so the atlas keeps it low (p90 250 m). Adding "mountain" or "volcanic" to its map.terrain would raise it.
